answer.rationale: Memory 57 is strongest because it explicitly added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm. Memory 44 directly supports qualified pipeline, though downstream revenue and retention are not stated. Memories 31 and 73 show durable activation or acquisition/revenue effects but omit qualification, retention, and longer-term economics. Memory 86 shows early adoption improvements but no revenue-quality or retention evidence. Memory 91 is least supported because it reports week-one engagement and first-action gains only, with no demonstrated conversion, revenue, qualification, or retention impact.
